title: sophora microphylla subsp. macnabiana
intro: Sophora microphylla subsp. macnabiana, commonly known as Kowhai, is a shrub or small tree native to New Zealand. The plant has been traditionally used in Maori medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin problems, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Sophora microphylla subsp. macnabiana include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
